title: Design System: Humanizer Documentation
northStar: The Working Proof Sheet: an editorial, code-forward documentation world where real C# input and output prove Humanizer.

typography.docsDisplay: Iowan Old Style, Baskerville, Times New Roman, serif
typography.homeDisplay: Avenir Next, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif
typography.body: Avenir Next, Segoe UI, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: background: var(--ifm-font-color-base); color: var(--ifm-background-color); min-height: 2.75rem; border-radius: 0;

components.name: Supported Culture List
components.css: display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(7rem, 1fr)); gap: 0.75rem 1rem;

rules: Teal signals navigation or capability; rust labels structure or focus.
Use ruled separation or a tone change instead of elevation.
Keep every claim version-correct and behaviorally verified.
Every listed culture supports every applicable localized feature.
dos: Keep NuGet installation and proof in the first viewport.
Preserve visible focus and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Do not add cards, pills, gradients, decorative shadows, or invented imagery.
Do not invent metrics, customers, testimonials, or benchmarks.
Do not present partial-culture capability tiers.
